treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Austria and the Government of the Republic of Armenia for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2002, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: [AT list] Armenien / Armenia Unterzeichnung / Date of Signature | 27.2.2002 | Inkrafttreten / Entry into Force | 1.3.2004 | Anwendbar ab / Effective From | 2005 | Abkommenstext / Treaty Text | BGBl III 29/2004 idF MLI || [AM MLI position] ...on Capital Republic of Austria Original 27-02-2002 01-04-2004
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the AT-AM Convention (MLISynthesizedTextAustria.docx, Armenian MoF, prepared jointly by AT and AM competent authorities)

rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of the Convention, a benefit under the Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit

notes: Art. 11(3): interest exempt at source on sale-on-credit of equipment/capital goods between enterprises, on loans of any nature (not bearer) granted by a banking enterprise, and paid to the other State/subdivisions/local authorities. MLI Art. 8 (365-day holding) not applied to this treaty (no box in synthesised text). Art. 28(2)(a): WHT provisions effective for income derived on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (EIF 2004 -> 2005-01-01). EIF date conflict (AT 2004-03-01 vs AM MLI position 2004-04-01) does not change valid_from. MLI WHT effect 2024-01-01 taken from treaty map.
